const LOCO_LEN = 150, CART_LEN = 62, COUP = 10, TENDER0 = 160;
function segs(){
  const out = [{ type:'loco', y0: 0, y1: LOCO_LEN }];
  out.push({ type:'tender', y0: TENDER0, y1: TENDER0 + CART_LEN });
  let off = TENDER0 + CART_LEN + COUP;
  for (const c of S.train.carts){ out.push({ ...c, y0: off, y1: off + CART_LEN }); off += CART_LEN + COUP; }
  return out; // worldY = t.y + y0..y1
}
function trainLen(){ return TENDER0 + CART_LEN + (CART_LEN+COUP) * S.train.carts.length; }
function zoneAt(ly){
  const t = S.train;
  if (ly < LOCO_LEN) return { type:'loco', y0:0, y1:LOCO_LEN };
  if (ly < TENDER0) return null;
  if (ly < TENDER0 + CART_LEN) return { type:'tender', ... };
  let off = TENDER0 + CART_LEN + COUP;
  for (const c of t.carts){ if (ly < off + CART_LEN) return {...c, y0:off, y1:off+CART_LEN}; off += CART_LEN+COUP; }
  return null;
}

Fixed the workshop build-access deadlock in `index.html`:

- BUILD is now available while aboard if the train has no workshop yet, so the first workshop can be constructed.
- Until that workshop exists, only the workshop itself can be built. Afterward, building requires standing inside a workshop car.
- The BUILD button and cart list now reflect those access rules, and the intro explains the first-workshop flow.

Validated the embedded JavaScript syntax with Node.
